BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF JULY 9, 2019, AND JULY 10, 2019
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of July 9, 2019, and July 10, 2019.

C.

D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1475 AND 64
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 19-5505 approving Warrant Register No. 1475 and Resolution No. SA 19-94 approving Warrant Register No. 64.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1475
D-1 Warrants Resolution SA #64
D-2
PRESENTATION OF JUNE 2019 INVESTMENT REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-2 June Investment Report Staff Report
D-2 June Investment Report Attachments A-E
D-3
PRESENTATION OF JUNE 2019 REQUISITION SUMMARY REPORT
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file this report.
D-3 June Requisition Report Staff Report
D-3 June Requisition Report Attachment A Report
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT TO ALFARO COMMUNICATION CONSTRUCTION, INC. FOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL SAFETY IMPROVEMENTS AT AMAR ROAD AND WILLOW AVENUE IN THE AMOUNT OF $178,700
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award the contract to Alfaro Communication Construction, Inc. in the amount of $178,700.00 and authorize the City Manager to execute the contract on behalf of the City; (2) authorize the City Manager to approve change orders up to 10% of the original bid amount; and (3) appropriate an additional $22,200 in Measure R funds to cover the total cost of the Project.
D-4 Alfaro Amar Willow Traffic Signal Staff Report
D-4 Alfaro Amar Willow Traffic Signal Attachment A Agreement
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 19-5494 AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM FOR FULL-TIME POSITIONS TO ADD A PUBLIC INFORMATION OFFICER/INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ANALYST
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 19-5506 rescinding Resolution No. 19-5494 and approving authorized full-time positions and salary ranges.
D-5 Full-Time PIO IT Analyst Staff Report
D-5 Full-Time PIO IT Analyst Attachment A Resolution
D-5 Full-Time PIO IT Analyst Attachment B Job Description
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF APPROVAL OF AGREEMENT WITH ENTERPRISE FLEET MANAGEMENT FOR LEASE/REPLACEMENT OF CITY MOTOR POOL VEHICLES AND A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2019/20 OPERATING BUDGET
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Agreement with Enterprise Fleet Management for a City motor pool lease program and authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City; and (2) adopt Resolution No. 19-5507 amending the adopted Operating Budget for Fiscal Year 2019/20 in the amount of $90,000.00.
D-6 Enterprise Fleet Management Vehicle Lease Staff Report
D-6 Enterprise Fleet Management Vehicle Lease Attachment A Analysis
D-6 Enterprise Fleet Management Vehicle Lease Attachment B Resolution
D-6 Enterprise Fleet Management Vehicle Lease Attachment C Agreements
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL – None
RECESS THE CITY COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING AND CONVENE THE LA PUENTE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY MEETING
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the Public Financing Authority on an item other than a public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the Authority Secretary no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker’s remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY
PFA-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION OF THE LA PUENTE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY DECLARING ITS INTENTION TO REIMBURSE CERTAIN EXPENDITURES FROM THE PROCEEDS OF A TAX-EXEMPT BOND FINANCING, AS REQUIRED BY UNITED STATES DEPARTMENT OF TREASURY REGULATIONS SECTION 1.150-2; AND AGREEMENTS APPROVING FINANCING TEAM MEMBERS
It is recommended that the La Puente Public Financing Authority: (1) adopt Resolution No. PFA 19-08 to declare its intention to reimburse certain expenditures from the proceeds of a tax-exempt bond financing, as required by United States Department of Treasury Regulations Section 1.150-2; and (2) approve agreements with financing team members and authorize the Executive Director to execute the agreements on behalf of the City.
PFA-1 Sales Tax Bonds Staff Report
PFA-1 Sales Tax Bonds Attachment A Resolution
PFA-1 Sales Tax Bonds Attachment B Wolf Agreement
PFA-1 Sales Tax Bonds Attachment C Norton Rose Fulbright
PFA-1 Sales Tax Bonds Attachment D HilltopSecurities
ADJOURN THE LA PUENTE PUBLIC FINANCING AUTHORITY AND RECONVENE THE CITY COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING

AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
